name: agrirover
description: Smart Agriculture Rover — Full-Stack IoT Platform on Render + EMQX Cloud

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && mkdir -p node_modules/.bin && cp bin/agrirover.js node_modules/.bin/agrirover && chmod +x node_modules/.bin/agrirover bin/agrirover.js agrirover
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
